goal: Highest listen range that still fits a citizen roof and a Reichelt cart. Listen only. Nothing flies.

ears.what: One radio. Bluetooth and Wi-Fi broadcast of EU Direct Remote ID (EN 4709-002). Not four streams. One ear.
ears.range_note: Open field, external 2 dBi antenna, line of sight. Urban street canyon much less. Not measured on our roof yet.

ears.what: Four MEMS capsules making ONE stream. They are not four cameras. Together they raise signal-to-noise and can guess a direction. Fibre-optic FPV has no radio. This is the ear for that.
ears.range_note: ReSpeaker vendor sheet says 5 m for speech. A DJI-class rotor is louder and tonal. Suburban quiet, roof height: 80 to 250 m is the working hypothesis. City noise eats that.

later.note: Pi Camera Module 3 looking up. Never first detector.

brain.role: Node brain. Needs 5 V / 5 A. Sends DETECTION over HTTPS to the Wunderglobe central.

items.name: Raspberry Pi 5 B 4 GB
items.role_en: Brain. Designed Cambridge, built Pencoed, Wales.
items.role_de: Gehirn. Entwurf Cambridge, Bau Pencoed, Wales.

items.name: Raspberry Pi 27 W USB-C PSU 5.1 V / 5 A
items.sku: in RPI 5B 4GB Black Bundle, or official 27W
items.role_en: Power. The Pi 5 wants 5 A. A phone charger will throttle it.
items.role_de: Strom. Der Pi 5 will 5 A. Ein Handy-Lader drosselt ihn.

items.name: Seeed ReSpeaker XVF3800 4-Mic with ESP32-S3
items.role_en: Ear 2. Four MEMS, beamforming, direction of arrival, USB to the Pi. Vendor speech range 5 m. Rotor range is the open measurement.
items.role_de: Ohr 2. Vier MEMS, Beamforming, Peilung, USB an den Pi. Hersteller: 5 m Sprache. Rotorreichweite ist die offene Messung.

items.name: ESP32-S3-MINI-1U-N8 (IPEX antenna)
items.role_en: Ear 1 radio. External antenna connector. This is the range lever for Remote ID.
items.role_de: Ohr-1-Funk. Buchse für Außenantenne. Das ist der Reichweitenhebel für Remote ID.

items.name: 2.4 / 5.8 GHz omni 2 dBi, U.FL, 108 mm
items.role_en: Put this outside the box. A PCB antenna inside an IP65 shell is a waste of the radio.
items.role_de: Die gehört nach draußen. Eine Leiterplattenantenne in einer IP65-Dose ist verschenkter Funk.

items.name: IP65 outdoor enclosure, vented
items.role_en: Weather. Drain holes. Mast clamp. Antenna gland.

items.name: USB-C and Ethernet 5 m
items.role_en: Power in, detections out through the house router to Wunderglobe.
items.role_de: Strom rein, Detektionen raus über den Hausrouter nach Wunderglobe.
